newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila stocks end up, no impact of inflation news.
newsitem.headline: Manila stocks end up, no impact of inflation news.

text.p: Manila shares finished slightly up on Tuesday despite lower-than-expected inflation level for October, traders said.
"Although the inflation rate of 4.7 is seen as positive, it failed to excite the market since it's already discounted," said Jonas Ferrer, research head of Pryce Securities Inc.
The main index crawled up at the close by 11.04 points, or 0.37 percent, to 2,987.18 points.
Traders said the market continued to seek direction although there was a slow improvement in sentiment.

Ayala Land B lifted the index with its 1 peso rise to 29 pesos. BPI which was suspended due to its secondary offering was one of the most active stocks after the listing of the secondary shares today, ending up by 5 pesos at 135 pesos.
Gainers and losers numbered the same at 53 with 76 issues unchanged. Value turnover was 6 billion pesos due to the block sale of BPI shares.
